name: qqq-cli-workspace
description: Reference CLI, generated TypeScript client, mock server and conformance suite for the QQQ UI API (/qqq/v1).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @qrun-io/qqq-ui-api-client && npm run build -w @qrun-io/qqq-core && npm run build -w @qrun-io/qqq-ui-api-conformance && npm run build -w @qrun-io/qqq-cli
scripts.test:tui: cd packages/tui && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun test
scripts.typecheck:tui: cd packages/tui && bun install --frozen-lockfile && npx tsc -p tsconfig.json
